TCD.note: Consultation was an in-person public hearing; nothing online.
Consultation is publicconsultation's; no cut or punishment stated.

facts.fact: HAMA held a day of public consultation at the Cefod on its draft specifications for web radio and web television, with private media managers present.
facts.system: HAMA public hearing on web radio and television specifications

facts.fact: HAMA's legal head says the hearing was required: article 43 of the audiovisual communication law has HAMA set specifications after a public hearing where civil society and interested parties give views.
